data.displayTitle: Associate Manager Operations & Maintenance - Onsite Operations
data.externalDescription:
• In this role you will be responsible for plant maintenance activities, planned and unplanned shutdowns activities.
  • Further you will supervise the installation, calibration, and commissioning of instruments like pressure transmitters, flow meters, and control valves etc.
  • Additionally, you will be responsible for troubleshooting and fixing faulty instruments to minimize downtime and optimize existing systems for better efficiency.
  • Furthermore, you will supervise scheduled calibration of sensors, valves, and transmitters (pressure, temperature, flow, and level) to ensure high-accuracy data.
  • Executing PM programs to proactively identify drift, wear, or potential instrument failures before they disrupt plant operations is a part of your responsibility.
  • Moreover, you are in charge for identifying and maintaining minimum stock levels of critical spares and consumables for reducing downtime.
